title: Explore climate adaptation through play
label: THE HEAT IS ON
lines: Welcome to The Heat Is On. Make decisions for your towns and discover how adaptation strategies build resilience.

title: Set up your game
label: 01 / GET STARTED
lines: Create a game, choose one to twenty rounds, and optionally enable the digital hazard wheel.
Five towns can play adaptation cards. Bludgeton is the comparison town and plays no cards.

title: Follow four steps each round
label: 02 / THE ROUND
lines: Each round moves through Adapt, Event, Review, and Dividends. The presenter uses the next-step button to guide the group.

title: Choose how to spend your effort points
label: 03 / ADAPT
lines: Select a town and a card. Check its cost, effects, and duration before confirming.
Landscaping, for example, costs fifteen effort points and improves all four bushfire resilience scores.

title: Put your strategy to the test
label: 04 / EVENT
lines: Spin the digital wheel, or select the result from a physical wheel. Confirm the hazard for all six towns.
Bushfire, flood, storm surge, heatwave, and biohazard each have different effects.

title: Read the charts. Compare the outcomes.
label: 05 / REVIEW
lines: Flip a town's chart to explore Nature, Economy, Society, and Health.
Compare hazard charts and Bludgeton to discuss what worked. Watch for low scores that can trigger cascading penalties.

title: Settle dividends before moving on
label: 06 / DIVIDENDS
lines: At round end, each resilience segment at exactly one hundred earns five effort points.
Confirm settlement to update budgets automatically. The final round also pays dividends. Do not add them twice.

title: Turn the results into learning
label: 07 / REFLECT
lines: Finish the game, or end it early, to review events, losses, final resilience, and budgets.
Compare all six towns. What would you do differently next time?
